query: AMD gross margin last four quarters

output.content:
AMD’s last four reported quarters are Q3 2025 through Q2 2026; GAAP gross margin was **52%, 54%, 53%, and 54%**, respectively. [[1, 2, 3, 4]]

| Quarter | GAAP gross margin | Non-GAAP gross margin |
|---|---:|---:|
| Q3 2025 | 52% | 54% |
| Q4 2025 | 54% | 57% |
| Q1 2026 | 53% | 55% |
| Q2 2026 | 54% | 56% |

The corresponding non-GAAP series was **54%, 57%, 55%, and 56%**. [[1, 2, 3, 4]] 

Using reported GAAP gross profit and revenue, the revenue-weighted gross margin across the four quarters was **53.2%**. [[1, 2, 3, 4]]
